6344ac8cca94e287.description: About Noon Academy Noon Academy is an EdTech platform focused on transforming education in the Middle East, particularly in Saudi Arabia. The company aims to integrate social, group-based learning and AI to enhance the physical classroom experience and provide access to quality teaching. With over 14 million students and teachers, Noon Academy operates as a well-funded and profitable entity, backed by $41 million in Series B funding. Role Overview Noon Academy is seeking an Accounting Manager to lead its accounting operations in Riyadh. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience, with a focus on delivering accurate and timely monthly closes across all entities. The position demands hands-on IFRS expertise and a background in external audit, involving the ability to manage complex transactions from contract review to financial statement disclosure. Key Responsibilities Manage the working day 0–7 close calendar, setting deadlines, resolving blockers, and ensuring timely delivery of reviewed trial balances and close packs. Determine and document accounting for revenue and receivables (IFRS 15 / IFRS 9), including student subscriptions, school and government contracts, unbilled and deferred revenue, and expected credit losses. Review technical accounting judgments for capitalised platform and content development (IAS 38), equipment (IAS 16), office leases (IFRS 16), end-of-service benefits (IAS 19), and convertible loan notes (IFRS 9 / IFRS 13), providing clear NetSuite posting instructions. Review material journals, balance sheet reconciliations, and P&L movements before close sign-off, ensuring approved adjustments are reflected in management reports and investor models. Oversee intercompany reconciliation, eliminations, and foreign currency translation (IAS 21) across multiple currencies (SAR, AED, EGP, PKR, GBP, INR). Lead the external audit process from planning to signed financial statements, resolving technical queries and coordinating with valuation specialists. Oversee VAT, Zakat, and corporate tax filings, along with ZATCA requirements in KSA and statutory compliance in other jurisdictions, in collaboration with the Compliance and Tax Accountant. Supervise and develop the GL team, strengthen review controls, maintain the account ownership matrix, and reduce recurring close and audit adjustments. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5–7 years of total experience, including at least 2 years in external audit (Big Four preferred) and at least 2 years in industry with ownership of the monthly close and audit. Possession of an ACA, ACCA, CPA, SOCPA, or equivalent qualification. Demonstrated strong, hands-on IFRS knowledge, particularly IFRS 15 for subscription and contract revenue, IFRS 9 expected credit losses, IAS 38 capitalisation, and IFRS 16. Experience with multi-entity, multi-currency close and consolidation, including intercompany eliminations and translation. Ability to provide concrete examples of defending judgments with auditors and delivering a close under tight deadlines. Work Location This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

6375957a2b2c9c51.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Cluster Finance Director to join its team. This full-time role, designated as SN7, involves overseeing all finance, accounting, treasury, procurement controls, financial planning, reporting, and governance functions across multiple hotels within the portfolio. The Cluster Finance Director will report to the Cluster General Manager and serve as a strategic business partner to ownership and hotel leadership teams. Role Context and Impact This position plays a critical role throughout the pre-opening, opening, stabilization, and operational phases of the hotels. The focus is on ensuring sound financial management, strong governance, effective cash flow planning, and long-term value creation. The role combines commercial acumen, financial stewardship, and project finance expertise to support a diverse portfolio of hotels with varying positioning, customer segments, and operating models. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with ownership and hotel leadership to establish robust financial processes, drive profitability, manage risk, and support strategic decision-making across the portfolio. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute a cluster-wide financial strategy aligned with ownership objectives, business plans, and brand standards. Serve as a strategic advisor to the Cluster General Manager and hotel leadership teams on financial opportunities, risks, and business performance. Lead all finance-related pre-opening activities, including developing the Finance Pre-Opening Critical Path and readiness plan, and managing Pre-Opening Budgets (POB). Establish accounting structures, financial controls, approval matrices, and reporting frameworks prior to opening. Lead the preparation of annual budgets, business plans, forecasts, and long-range financial projections, consolidating financial planning across multiple entities. Develop and manage cash flow forecasts, monitor working capital, and oversee treasury activities, banking relationships, and cash management processes. Oversee all accounting, financial reporting, audit, tax, compliance, and internal control activities, ensuring accuracy and timeliness. Experience supporting working capital planning, funding requests, and treasury management activities. Strong knowledge of financial controls, accounting standards, audits, tax compliance, and governance requirements. 63bffcce51034a27.job_title: متحدث ومقدم عروض في معرض دولي – عمل مؤقت

634765e17bb9d5de.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مراكز الاتصال عن مأمور سنترال للانضمام إلى فريقها في القصيم. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإشراف على عمليات تشغيل مقسمات الهاتف، وإدارة المكالمات الواردة والصادرة، وضمان سير العمليات الاتصالية بسلاسة وفعالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على تشغيل مقسمات الهاتف ولوحات تحويل الاتصالات الهاتفية ووحدات التحكم الخاصة بها، بما في ذلك توصيل المكالمات وتعليقها وتحويلها وقطعها. الرد على المكالمات الواردة، والترحيب بالمتصلين، وتقديم المعلومات اللازمة، وتحويل المكالمات إلى الأقسام أو الأشخاص المعنيين. تلقي الرسائل الموجهة إلى الموظفين أو العملاء وترحيلها وتسجيلها حسب الحاجة. متابعة حالة الأجهزة الهاتفية والمقسمات، والتأكد من الإبلاغ السريع عن أي أعطال في الأجهزة أو الهواتف أو الخطوط، والمساهمة في صيانتها بأسرع وقت ممكن. ضمان الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة للعمل والتقيد بها. رفع التقارير الفنية الدورية للإدارة حول سير العمل، وتوضيح أي صعوبات أو تحديات قد تعيق الأداء. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع أنظمة ومقسمات الهاتف بكفاءة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة ولباقة في التعامل مع المتصلين. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وإدارة الوقت. القدرة على حل المشكلات والإبلاغ عنها بفعالية. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات المحددة. بيئة العمل يعمل مأمور السنترال ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية في مراكز الاتصال بالقصيم، حيث يتطلب الدور التواجد بدوام كامل لضمان استمرارية العمليات الاتصالية. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل متخصص في القصيم، والمساهمة في إدارة العمليات اليومية لمقسمات الهاتف. الراتب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

639c2069c8d4f464.description: About Modern Mills Company Modern Mills Company is seeking a Manager Project Management Office to join its team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role focuses on the planning, governance, execution, and completion of all CAPEX and civil projects within the company. Role Purpose The Manager Project Management Office will lead multimillion-SAR projects involving complex civil engineering works. This position requires a strong focus on budgeting, costing, schedule control, quality, and regulatory compliance. The role involves developing and reviewing CAD drawings and technical deliverables, and applying formal PMO governance to ensure consistent and transparent project delivery. A key responsibility is to ensure all technical and design aspects of each project comply with Saudi government regulations. Key Responsibilities Develop project charters and plans, defining scope, budget, schedule, resources, deliverables, dependencies, and acceptance criteria for CAPEX and operational projects. Establish and manage PMO governance, including stage gates, portfolio prioritization, project controls, dashboards, document control, change control, and escalation routines. Define project goals and KPIs aligned with corporate objectives, evaluate feasibility, conduct cost-benefit analyses, and secure management approvals. Prepare, review, and coordinate CAD drawings, layouts, design packages, specifications, and as-built documentation for civil works. Manage multimillion-SAR budgets, optimize resources, and apply cost controls to prevent overruns and identify savings. Develop detailed schedules, monitor progress and critical paths, and adjust resources or recovery plans to address delays. Provide accurate portfolio and project reporting, including forecasts, variance analysis, milestones, risks, issues, and required decisions. Ensure designs and construction comply with project specifications, civil engineering standards, Saudi regulations, permits, and applicable international standards. Establish quality plans, review technical submittals, conduct site inspections, manage non-conformities, and verify completed work against drawings and specifications. Partner with the EHS team to enforce safety requirements and reduce construction and operational risks. Ensure design and construction meet the latest standards required by auditing bodies such as ISO and BRC, and by key customers. Act as the primary contact for project communication, coordinating internal teams, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and regulatory authorities. Select, manage, and evaluate contractors against scope, quality, schedule, safety, and budget commitments. Capture lessons learned, standardize project management practices, and implement improvements that reduce cost and cycle time while improving quality and predictability. Engage proactively with partners and vendors to understand each one's role in the overall design and how they interface with each other, bringing all parties together to simplify the design and achieve savings in capital expenditure, utilities, and labor. Required Qualifications and Experience Experience in project management focused on CAPEX and civil projects. Preferably experience in a high-value, multi-stakeholder industrial or manufacturing environment. Substantial PMO experience, including project governance, portfolio reporting, stage gates, risk and issue management, change control, and executive reporting. Proven experience managing contractors, consultants, civil works, budgets, schedules, quality, and regulatory approvals in Saudi Arabia. Work Type This is a full-time position.

The primary hub for alfanar’s industrial activities is the alfanar Industrial Complex in Riyadh, spanning 700,000 square meters and housing comprehensive infrastructure. Role Overview alfanar Electric is seeking a Sr. HSE Engineer to provide advanced technical support for Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) across assigned areas. This full-time role involves conducting risk assessments, performing inspections, investigating incidents, and verifying operational controls during day or night shifts. The Sr. HSE Engineer will contribute to strengthening compliance, emergency readiness, and technical competency through guidance, analysis, and effective shift handover processes in Riyadh and Al Jubail, Saudi Arabia. The position requires 6-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Conduct complex risk assessments, including ATEX/hazardous-area classification, machinery safety, chemical exposure, and fire risks, and develop appropriate assessment methodologies. Review assessments prepared by engineers and inspectors, verifying the adequacy of proposed mitigation measures. Assess HSE controls for contractor activities, maintenance, shutdowns, projects, and production line modifications. Support occupational exposure assessments and verify environmental controls for chemicals, waste, and spill prevention. Develop inspection schedules and conduct planned patrols of high-risk areas during assigned shifts, providing technical guidance on inspection priorities. Participate in cross-factory audits and conduct ISO 45001/14001 internal audits as assigned. Verify permit-to-work, hot work, and lockout/tagout compliance for operational, maintenance, and contractor activities, identifying deviations from approved procedures. Verify valid third-party certification of regulated equipment and required operator licenses, exercising stop-work authority when unsafe conditions present unacceptable risk. Investigate serious and high-potential incidents using advanced root cause analysis methods and recommend actions to address underlying causes. Provide immediate incident response, coordinate with emergency teams, secure the scene for investigation, and escalate serious incidents to the HSE Manager without delay. Maintain area emergency response arrangements and participate in drills aligned with Civil Defense requirements. Coach engineers and inspectors, contribute to competency assessments, and develop structured technical development plans. Develop training materials and deliver awareness campaigns, toolbox talks, and technical training, including for permit issuers and receivers. Develop improvements to inspection methods, digital reporting, and operational controls, benchmarking good practices and measuring their impact. Analyze HSE findings, incident trends, and KPIs, presenting findings and technical recommendations to stakeholders. Track corrective actions through closure and verify their effectiveness. Prepare shift HSE reports and manage handover of incidents, significant risks, and outstanding actions between day and night teams to ensure continuity of HSE coverage. Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets as per delivery schedules, utilizing resources effectively within cost and time constraints. Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automation opportunities. Comply with relevant policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure compliance with relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls within the defined area of work activity. Experience and Work Type This is a full-time position requiring 6-10 years of experience in a relevant HSE role. The successful candidate will be based in either Riyadh or Al Jubail, Saudi Arabia, and will be expected to work day or night shifts as assigned to ensure continuous HSE coverage.
